correctness.rationale: Direct connected-set partition gives z^rQ; (z-1)Q identity excludes imaginary-axis roots for every real r>1. Continuity and r→infinity cyclotomic perturbation prove exact 2 floor(h/4) right-half-plane zeros. A strictly unimodal real-variable function determines negative roots and the only tangency, with F-prime ruling out further multiples. Brute subset enumerations (32 cases) and numerical root checks (240 parameter cases) corroborate, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: Exact complex-root geometry for all hub degrees and arbitrary arm length identifies a sharp Hurwitz transition at h=4 and adds one right-half-plane conjugate pair after each four added long-arm vertices, independent of arbitrarily many short arms. The parity-sensitive negative-real census and unique double-root event complete a motivated structural root-locus classification unavailable from a small count table. General root geometry of graph generating polynomials and forcing-polynomial shape are natural topics.
